@graph.headline: How Long Can a Facebook Reel Be? 2026 Limits and Best Run Times
@graph.description: Facebook Reels no longer stop at 90 seconds. Get the 2026 length limits, the specs to check before you post, and the run times that actually get watched.

mainEntity.name: Can a Facebook Reel be 3 minutes long?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you upload it as a finished file and your account has the June 2025 update. The in-app camera still won't record that long.

mainEntity.name: What's the shortest a Facebook Reel can be?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3 seconds. Through SocialBee's direct Facebook Page publishing, 4 seconds.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Facebook Reel still cap at 90 seconds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your account probably hasn't received the change yet. Upload a finished file rather than recording in the app, and check whether you're posting to a Page or a personal profile.

mainEntity.name: Do longer Facebook Reels get less reach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not because of their length. Fewer people finish them, and completion is what Facebook rewards.

mainEntity.name: Is there a length limit for Facebook Reels ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meta publishes no maximum for the Reels placement. Keep ads under 30 seconds regardless, because a cold audience gives you very little patience.

mainEntity.name: Can I post a horizontal video as a Reel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, and it'll publish. It gets shown in a vertical frame, so shoot 9:16 when you have the choice.
